content.text:
Moneo now catches recurring changes on its own and shows them on Overview as cards to confirm. Everything is merged to main in [PR #114](https://github.com/indkhan/Moneo/pull/114) (merge commit `e92873e8`).

**What it catches:**
- **New recurring payments** found in your transactions show up on Overview as "Netflix: −EUR 12.99 monthly, confirm as recurring?"
- **Amount changes** on payments you've already confirmed show up as "Netflix went up: update to −EUR 13.99". Confirm updates the schedule; Dismiss keeps the current amount. These cards also appear on the Recurring page.

**Same backend as chat:** these are now the same kind of proposal that chat creates, and Confirm runs the same save path as the Recurring page dialog. Each change is raised only once, so a dismissed card doesn't come back. If you handle something on the Recurring page first, its card closes by itself.

**Tested in the browser:** I added three charges of 12.99 and the new pattern appeared on Overview. After I confirmed it with a category, I added a 13.99 charge. Overview showed "went up", and Confirm changed the schedule to 13.99 and kept the category. Tests, lint and build pass.

**Things to know:**
- **Migration:** `202610280003_recurring_categories.sql` was already applied to your Supabase database earlier. It's now on main too.
- **Merged before checks finished:** Vercel and GitGuardian were still running when I merged, as you asked to merge directly. Worth a glance at the Vercel deploy.
- **Saves when Overview opens:** detection runs and stores any new cards each time Overview (or Recurring) opens, rather than in the background.
- **Big jumps:** a price change is only spotted when the new charge stays within about 15% of the old amount. A bigger jump looks like a different payment, so it shows up later as a new pattern to confirm instead.
- **Chat:** asking for these changes in chat still hasn't been tested with a real model reply, because OpenRouter is out of credits.
